scope: Ten identities and local checks for the six-field formulation of the joint Hug–Navier evolution.
open_items: Conditional identities do not prove a full PDE trajectory exists.
Pressure equivalence is not nonuniqueness of the evolving state.
Local guard boundary signs do not prove global guard invariance.
Source-to-formalization fidelity was manually reviewed, not proved by Comparator.
Native equations are exact-real statements, not a certificate of the numerical solver.
Initial-value solution class still needs analytic estimates and any required strengthened regularity.
A/S kernel/domain/initial/boundary/response assumptions still have to be fixed for a particular existence theorem.
